newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil high court starts ruling on CVRD sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Brazil high court starts ruling on CVRD sell-off.

text.p: Brazil's highest court, the Supreme Federal Tribunal (STF), began a ruling Wednesday on a constitutional challenge to the upcoming privatization of state mining giant CVRD, an official said.

A full session of the STF began studying an action of unconstitutionality brought by the Order of Brazilian Lawyers (OAB), a private lawyers group, which questions the validity of a 1990 privatization law.

The OAB has said the privatization law, which serves as a legal framework for all federal privatizations in Brazil, is questionable due to legal actions brought against it in the past which have not been fully resolved.

The STF was considering the possibility of issuing an injunction to halt the privatization of CVRD due to begin April 29 with the auction of a 40-45-percent voting stake in the company on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.

The STF was also expected to rule Wednesday on an appeal by the government against an injunction issued Tuesday which suspends the federal land transfer to CVRD of 411,000 hectares of land in the Carajas mining region in the northern state of Para.
Another constitutional challenge to the privatization of CVRD lodged by the OAB was due to be studied by the STF at a later date.
